title: Early NFL BEST BETS & Survivor Pool Picks: Week 8 Predictions (2026)
transcript_summary: Matt Perrault and Pat Fitzmaurice preview NFL Week 8 betting action, sharing their top survivor pool selections and early spread and total bets. Key discussions highlight survivor picks in Jacksonville and Cincinnati, along with best bets on Green Bay, Buffalo, Cleveland, and an under in the Colts-Jaguars matchup.

speaker_segments.text: Welcome to Week 8 of the NFL season. Reflecting on a crazy week for survivor pools with major upsets, and introducing today's show.

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: Introduces Week 8 survivor pick: Jacksonville Jaguars at home against the Indianapolis Colts.

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: Explains why the Colts are a team to target as morale is low and Jacksonville is settling into form at home.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: Agrees on targeting Indianapolis, citing rumors surrounding the trade deadline and internal franchise turmoil.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: Expands on Colts roster concerns and trade rumors involving core players.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: Presents Week 8 survivor pick: Cincinnati Bengals at home against the Tennessee Titans.

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: Reacts to the Bengals selection, agreeing that Joe Burrow and the offense are clicking well.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: Presents Week 8 best bet: Buffalo Bills -3.5 vs Baltimore Ravens.

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault
speaker_segments.text: Presents Week 8 best bet: Cleveland Browns +3.5 vs Pittsburgh Steelers.

speaker_segments.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
speaker_segments.text: Agrees with taking Cleveland +3.5, noting Pittsburgh's inability to blow teams out.

speaker_segments.speaker: Matt Perrault

analysis_notes.summary: The Colts are perceived as being at a low point in morale with trade rumors swirling around core veterans.
analysis_notes.speaker: Matt Perrault
analysis_notes.quote: Indy's in deep trouble. Indianapolis is a mess.

analysis_notes.summary: Rams favored over Chargers at SoFi Stadium, with Chargers facing questions about team direction.
analysis_notes.speaker: Matt Perrault
analysis_notes.quote: If you haven't burned the Rams yet, I still think that that's a really smart play.

analysis_notes.summary: Pat warns against using Dallas as a large survivor favorite on a short week against a plucky Arizona team.
analysis_notes.speaker: Pat Fitzmaurice
analysis_notes.quote: Six and a half seems like a lot for a team, Dallas, that has not really shown it has its act completely together.

analysis_notes.summary: The hosts note Kansas City's lack of playmaking depth outside of Kelce and express caution taking them in Denver.
analysis_notes.speaker: Matt Perrault
analysis_notes.quote: They never got to the red zone... I'm not so sure the Chiefs go to Denver and just walk all over the Broncos.
